entities.summary: Lavoisier Maia Sobrinho was a Brazilian physician, Professor and politician, affiliated with the Brazilian Social Democracy Party (PSDB). He served as the 44th governor of Rio Grande do Norte, from 1979 to 1983, as well as senator, federal deputy and state deputy.
